The MLC Election Result 2026 has delivered a major setback to the Congress in Karnataka.
The Congress failed to win any of the four Legislative Council seats contested in the state.
The BJP won three seats, while the JDS secured one seat with BJP support. The results are significant as Karnataka is currently governed by the Congress.
The defeat has raised questions over the Congress strategy and the leadership of Rahul Gandhi and D.K. Shivakumar.
